blocks.content: Use `pushtopics.ExecutionService` to start Batch executions of Executables and Pipelines from Apex. You can run an Executable by its configured criteria or specific record IDs, and run a Pipeline with optional additional Retrieve parameters.
To start executions from an external system or another org, use the [[rest-api]] instead.

children.content: Starts a Batch execution of the specified Executable using its configured Retrieve Criteria.

rows.description: The API Name of the Executable to run.

children.content: A `pushtopics__Execution__c` record representing the execution created for this request.
Starts a Batch execution of the specified Executable, using the provided record IDs in addition to the Executable's configured Retrieve Criteria.

rows.description: The API Name of the Executable to run.
The IDs of the source records to include in the retrieval.

children.content: A `pushtopics__Execution__c` record representing the execution created for this request.
Executes the Batch Executables in the specified Pipeline and returns the created Pipeline Execution record. Use this overload when no additional Retrieve parameters are needed.

rows.description: The API Name of the Pipeline to run.

children.content: A `pushtopics__PipelineExecution__c` record representing the Pipeline Execution created for this request.
Start a Batch run of the Executables in `Opportunity.Batches`:
Executes the Batch Executables in the specified Pipeline with additional Retrieve parameters, such as filter conditions and `ORDER BY` clauses, applied to their configured source retrieval queries.

rows.description: The API Name of the Pipeline to run.
Additional Retrieve parameters for the Pipeline's Batch Executables. Use a String to apply the same parameters to all Batch Executables, or a Map to specify parameters for individual Executables.

children.content: A `pushtopics__PipelineExecution__c` record representing the Pipeline Execution created for this request.
